item.meaning: A number that divides another integer completely without leaving a remainder.
The product of a given number and any non-zero integer.
Two positive integers whose Highest Common Factor (HCF) is 1.

item.definition: The largest positive integer that divides each of two or more non-zero integers without leaving a remainder.
The smallest positive integer that is a multiple of two or more given integers.

item.description: Decomposing numbers into prime factors to efficiently determine HCF (lowest prime powers) and LCM (highest prime powers).

item.statement: For any two positive integers a and b: HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b) = a × b.

item.formula_expression: HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b) = a × b

item.relationship_name: HCF, LCM, and Product of Two Numbers
item.description: The product of HCF and LCM of any two numbers equals the product of those two numbers.
The alignment of repeating cycles (bells tolling, runners on a track) follows the common multiples of their cycle lengths, with first re-alignment at LCM.

item.application: When dividing rectangular spaces or packing items into equal maximum dimensions without waste, calculate HCF.
When finding the earliest time or shortest distance for multiple periodic events to align simultaneously, calculate LCM.
